title: Local wins compose into a global loss
caption: Architecture, compression and serving each hit their metric. The failure lived between them: INT8 clipping ranges met a firmware-specific preprocessing path, the input shifted on one cohort, and aggregate telemetry never saw the four-point drop.

title: Five lighthouses, five limiting terms
caption: Each lighthouse saturates one resource first — compute, bandwidth, capacity, compute-in-envelope, power. The regime belongs to the workload on a machine; batch, phase and precision can move it.

title: Thirteen principles, three questions
caption: The book's quantitative toolkit sorted by what shapes predictions, what limits execution, and what evidence supports deployment — with each tool's kind (bound, decomposition, fitted model, policy, heuristic) marked.

title: One request, four limiting terms
caption: The closing voice-assistant trace: KWS power-bound, the front end compute-in-envelope, DLRM capacity-bound, GPT-2 decode bandwidth-bound — four different physics inside one user request.
